name: Orak-Thuun
notes: The First Builders. Biomechanical engineers active millions of years ago who fused organic forms with planetary-scale constructs; built massive Dyson swarms, ringworlds, gravity lattices, and deep-space megastructures. Vanished mysteriously; their self-sustaining technology still functions in abandoned systems — the Dyson Sphere Frontier (loc_dyson_twin_spheres), the Hollow Expanse (loc_hollow_expanse), and the Xyphos Prime ruins (loc_xyphos_prime_ruins). Status extinct (vanished).
